import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { executeSoulSupplyChoice } from '@src/response-apps/soulPath/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { getCommandArgument, sendSoulGui } from '@src/response/soulPath/shared';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const result = await executeSoulSupplyChoice(e.UserId, e.uid as number, getCommandArgument(e.MessageText, '神魂补给'), createBackendRequestContext(e));
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText(result.message);
  void message.send(sendSoulGui(e, '神魂补给', md, [{ label: '神魂面板', command: '/元婴神魂' }]));
});
